verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a dedicated 'vastai agent skill' explicitly enabling AI coding assistants to drive the platform via natural-language-style requests (create instances, deploy endpoints, manage keys, check balances), backed by a full CLI/API/SDK stack for automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the agent skill in real NL workflows, and detail on how natural-language commands map to underlying API calls beyond the skill wrapper.
